TWINE - 007: The World Is Not Enough, native PC port (Windows)
==============================================================

You need your own copy of the game: the American PlayStation disc (SLUS-01272), as a
disc image (.cue and .bin, as DuckStation or a disc ripper makes). Nothing else needs
installing.

1. Unpack this folder anywhere (not inside Program Files).
2. Run twine.exe.
3. The first time, choose your disc image. It is checked and remembered.

A PS1 BIOS is optional: it only plays the console's start-up animation.

This folder is portable: the file named "portable" keeps the settings, saves, memory cards
and log in the twine folder next to twine.exe. Delete that file to keep them in
%APPDATA%\twine instead.

Settings:  twine\twine.ini   (twine.exe --setup shows the disc screen again)
Log:       twine\port.log

HD movies (optional, from your own copy of the film): see tools\hdmovies.py and the
project's README.
